verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in web UI for chatting and configuring agents, and a shell agent (`local-ai chat`) that reads files and runs commands. Nothing in the evidence describes an integrated document workspace where an agent drafts and edits documents with automatic saving. Editing saved chat messages and running shell commands are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
